title: AI Gateway Bedrock passthrough token usage: reuse the Anthropic usage helpers so Bedrock traces record tokens and cost
answers: Why do Bedrock Claude traces show blank input and output tokens or cost on the gateway?
How is token usage parsed for Anthropic Messages responses from Bedrock?
Where is the Anthropic usage parsing shared between the Anthropic and Bedrock providers?
What must change together if Anthropic streaming usage parsing is modified?
body:
Path: Token usage extraction for passthrough responses and streaming chunks from `AmazonBedrockProvider` when the model is Claude. `AmazonBedrockProvider._extract_passthrough_token_usage` and `_extract_streaming_token_usage` feed the trace span and the usage aggregation.
Rule: Bedrock's InvokeModel returns Anthropic response bodies and stream events unchanged, so both providers delegate to the module-level helpers `_extract_anthropic_passthrough_token_usage` and `_extract_anthropic_streaming_token_usage` in `mlflow/gateway/providers/anthropic.py`. Changes to Anthropic usage parsing (cache read/creation keys, input-token normalization, `message_start`/`message_delta` handling) apply to Bedrock too; keep the two providers' overrides delegating rather than copying the logic.
Symptom: Without these overrides, the span for a Bedrock passthrough request got no usage, so the trace showed blank tokens and cost.
Constraints: Applies to Anthropic-format bodies only; non-Claude Bedrock models are rejected before usage is extracted on the Messages passthrough.
applies: Token and cost accounting for the Anthropic Messages passthrough on Amazon Bedrock Claude models.
says: Traces for Bedrock Claude requests show blank token counts and zero cost.
Display input and output token usage in the trace view for Bedrock models.
Why is cost calculation missing from gateway traces on our Bedrock endpoints?
Record streaming token usage and expenses for Claude endpoints hosted on Bedrock.
search: AmazonBedrockProvider._extract_passthrough_token_usage and _extract_streaming_token_usage delegate to mlflow/gateway/providers/anthropic.py:_extract_anthropic_passthrough_token_usage and _extract_anthropic_streaming_token_usage to populate trace spans and usage aggregation for Bedrock Claude endpoints. Both providers share the helper logic for cache keys, input-token normalization, and message_start/message_delta handling because Bedrock InvokeModel returns Anthropic response bodies and events unchanged. Applies to Anthropic-format bodies only, and non-Claude Bedrock models are rejected before usage extraction.
